title: WebEvidenceResult
description: The 'result' payload shape when ProviderResponseEnvelope.capability='web_search' (Checkpoint Phase 4 C.0, docs/adr/0009-phase4-checkpointc0-live-data-and-react-design.md). A web result is evidence, not automatically a trusted fact -- 'source_type' lets the caller distinguish official sources from secondary or unknown publishers. This shape is deliberately distinct from contracts/SourceReference.schema.json (frozen RAG citations, docs/adr/0005-phase3-rag-ownership.md): a WebEvidenceItem is never silently converted into a SourceReference, and never presented as frozen corpus-backed knowledge.

published_at.description: null when the publication date is genuinely unknown -- never guessed or backfilled with retrieved_at.

snippet.description: A short extracted evidence snippet or fact, copied from the source -- never a model-generated summary presented as a direct quotation.

source_type.description: 'official' = government/venue/airline/carrier's own site; 'news'/'reference' = established editorial or encyclopedic publishers; 'secondary' = blogs/forums/aggregators; 'unknown' = publisher could not be classified. The orchestrator, never this tool, decides how much weight to give a source.
